additional_info.subject: Site visit
additional_info.body:
SiCharge D Dispenser Operating instructions were not followed correct by installer (Customer). The 7 wire signal cable indicated on page 58 of the document was not correctly installed which caused the fast shutdown and emergency shutdown signals to be missing in the dispenser. Causing the dispenser to not get into operational state.
Signal cable corrected on both SiChargeD and Dispenser side caused charger to be oprational.
Used customer car to verify working charge session on dispenser outlet.
